                                        ALKEON GROWTH PW PARTNERS, LP
                                      SERIES ONE AND SERIES TWO INTERESTS
                                   INSTRUCTIONS TO SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT


                         Any person desiring to become a limited partner of Alkeon Growth PW Partners, LP (the
         Partnership") should:

                                 (a) complete and execute the attached Subscription Agreement (the
                         "Agreement") including Appendix A (Electronic Communications) and Appendix B (Form
                         W-9), offering to make a capital contribution on a specified date (the "Admission Date') in
                         the amount set forth below his or her name at the end of the Agreement, and, if
                         requested by the Partnership, Appendix G ("AML Requirements");

                                 (b) execute the signature page of the Limited Partnership Agreement of the
                         Partnership (the "Partnership Agreement"); and

                               (c) e-mail the completed Agreement and si nature             a e of the Partnership
                         Agreement to Alkeon Capital Advisers, LLC at

                         The Partnership will advise each subscriber promptly of its acceptance of any offer to
         become a limited partner of the Partnership and confirm the Admission Date, but Alkeon Capital Advisers,
         LLC, the general partner of the Partnership, has the right to refuse any offer to become a limited partner
         for any reason.

                          Limited partners that would like to make an additional capital contribution, or that would
         like to withdraw their investment. may do so using the forms attached at the back of this Agreement.

                          Payment in United States currency by bank-to-bank wire transfer in the amount of the
         subscription, payable to the Partnership, must be received by the Partnership at least three business
         days prior to the Admission Date.

                         Payment by wire transfer should be sent to:

                                The Bank of New York Mellon
                                1 Wall Street New York. NY, USA
                                ABA#
                                Account Number:
                                Account Name: Alkeon Growth PW Partners, LP
                                FFC: [INVESTOR NAME AS IT APPEARS ON BANK ACCT. 8 SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT]

                        Failure to provide funds in one of the formats described above could result in a delay in
         the Admission Date.
